verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rippling serves an llms.txt at developer.rippling.com (HTTP 200) titled 'Rippling Developer Documentation'. It contains agent-directed instructions, so a user can point an agent at it. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs, evidence of how much of the developer docs it covers (e.g., llms-full.txt or markdown pages), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.rippling.com/llms.txt # Rippling Developer Documentation
